title: elatostema umbellatum var. involucratum
intro: Elatostema umbellatum var. involucratum, commonly known as the involucrate Elatostema, is a species of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, and it has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The health benefits of Elatostema umbellatum var. involucratum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
